landing.heroTitle: We transform food surplus into real social impact.
landing.heroSubtitle: FoodLink Solidario connects establishments with food surplus to foundations, community dining rooms, and organizations interested in putting it to good use.
landing.howItWorksDesc: FoodLink Solidario is a digital platform that aims to reduce food waste and facilitate the recovery of surplus food in Colombia. We connect establishments with food fit for consumption to foundations, organizations, and buyers interested in making the most of it. In this way, we promote responsible consumption, the circular economy, and positive social impact.
landing.step1Desc: Establishments, organizations, and buyers create an account on the platform and complete the requested information according to their type of participation.
landing.step2Desc: Establishments enabled as sellers publish their food surplus, indicating the type of product, available quantity, condition, location, and expiration date when applicable.
landing.step3Desc: Buyers check available foods, use search filters, and submit offers for the batches they are interested in, according to published conditions.
landing.step4Desc: Both parties can manage their offers and negotiations within the platform. Once conditions are agreed upon, they coordinate delivery or pickup of the food and update the operation status.
landing.stepsDisclaimer: The availability of each feature depends on the implemented tools and the actual status of the publication.
landing.purposeDesc: At FoodLink Solidario, we believe that food still fit for consumption deserves a second chance. Therefore, we seek to connect those with food surplus to those who can make the most of it, contributing to reducing food loss and waste, strengthening inter-organizational collaboration, and promoting a culture of social and environmental responsibility.
landing.pillarSocialDesc: Facilitate the recovery of food by organizations and communities.
landing.pillarEcoDesc: Promote the reduction of food loss and waste.
landing.pillarCircularDesc: Foster the responsible use of resources and collaboration among participants.
landing.catalogPreviewDesc: Explore lots of food fit for human consumption available on the FoodLink Solidario network.
landing.ctaDesc: Explore available food, discover how our network works, and participate in an initiative that seeks to transform food surplus into opportunities.
